integrity: Executable independent enumerations and their output records included; checks are mathematical exhaustions, not external certification.
scientific_limitations: Finite graph-specific computer-assisted enumeration; no claimed diameter or stochastic mixing time, and no formula for other Paley orders. Literature-search incompleteness and independent publication-priority verification remain residual risks.
title: A sharp palette threshold and a two-component recoloring obstruction for the thirteen-vertex Paley graph
